_doc: Heartbeat defaults. Instance overrides: .hb-heartbeat/state/config.json (untracked), same keys, shallow-merged. Read by hb.py/runner.py: window.open+close (in-window check, close computation), item_cap_min (ceiling; per-item time_cap_min may only lower it; the tick's near-close refusal uses it), count_cap, attempts_max, model, qa, pr, base_branch, branch_prefix, sandbox_rel, stale_branch_days, quota.*, extra_path, python. INFORMATIONAL ONLY (the schedule lives in win/register-tasks.ps1 parameters — re-register if you change them): tick_minutes, wsl_distro, wsl_user.
